content:
UPSESSB TGT 2022 Final Revised Result, College Allotment Result 2026 – Released ✅

Uttar Pradesh Secondary Education Service Selection Board (UPSESSB) has released the Final Revised Result and College / Institute Allotment Result for the Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) Recruitment 2022 under Advt. No. 01/2022.

Recruitment was notified for 3539 posts and the process included written examination, answer key, result, document verification, final result, and final college allotment. Candidates can now check their status on the official result portal.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 09/06/2022
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 10/07/2022
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date : 13/07/2022
  • Complete Form Last Date : 16/07/2022
  • UP TGT Exam Date : 03-04 June 2026
  • Exam City Available : 23/05/2026
  • Admit Card Available : 31/05/2026
  • Answer Key Available : 06/06/2026
  • Result Available : 30/06/2026
  • DV Letter Available : 02/07/2026
  • Final Result Available : 28/07/2026
  • Revised Final Result : 23/08/2026
  • College Allotment Result : 09/09/2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC : ₹750/-
  • EWS : ₹450/-
  • SC : ₹450/-
  • ST : ₹250/-

UP TGT 2022 Vacancy Details

Total Posts: 3539

  • Trained Graduate Teacher TGT (Balak) : 3213
  • Trained Graduate Teacher TGT (Balika) : 326

Subject-wise Recruitment Details

Vacancy was released across major subjects such as English, Hindi, Mathematics, Social Science, Sanskrit, Physical Education, Science, Home Science, Art, Commerce, Agriculture, Biology, Urdu, Music, and other teaching subjects.

  • English : 557 posts
  • Hindi : 557 posts
  • Mathematics : 533 posts
  • Social Science : 383 posts
  • Sanskrit : 291 posts
  • Physical Education : 170 posts
  • Science : 540 posts
  • Home Science : 179 posts
  • Art : 148 posts
  • Commerce : 38 posts
  • Agriculture : 47 posts
  • Biology : 50 posts
  • Urdu : 13 posts
  • Music / Singing / Instrumental : 35 posts

Eligibility Criteria

  • Bachelor Degree in the relevant subject with B.Ed. is required.
  • For subject-wise eligibility and age relaxation, refer to the official UPSESSB notification.
  • Minimum age : 21 years as on 01/07/2022.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official UPSESSB / UPESSC portal.
  2. Open the TGT result portal.
  3. Login with registration number and date of birth / password.
  4. Download the final revised result or college allotment PDF.
  5. Save the copy and follow the document verification or joining instructions.

Multiple subject-wise revised cutoff and result PDFs were also released for candidates belonging to different disciplines. Candidates are advised to read the official notice before following the allotment and verification instructions.

Note: This is a recruitment result update. Final appointment depends on eligibility verification, document verification, and completion of allotment / joining formalities as directed by the board.
